title: The handoff that came back
scenario:
You are the lead designer on a fitness app redesign. The screens are approved. Your studio exports the launch cards, hands the components to the app developers, and tries to sync the colour tokens to code.

Use the exhibit. Endpoint names, plan rules and messages are from Figma's and Canva's docs. The studio, the files and the results are made up for this case.
exhibit:
FIGMA EXPORT (made up result, GET image endpoint)
  ids: card_1 ... card_12, format=png, scale=2
  images: 11 URLs, and  "card_7": null
  card_7 has 0% opacity in the file

CANVA EXPORT (made up)
  export-design returned 6 signed URLs for the social posts.
  A teammate pasted the URLs into the shared launch doc
  "so the agency can download them next month".

CODE CONNECT (made up set-up)
  Plan: Organization. Mappings made with Code Connect UI.
  Developer: "The AI gets the Button's path and name, but not how
  Figma's Size property maps to our size prop."

TOKEN SYNC (made up)
  Script: GET /v1/files/:file_key/variables/local
  Studio plan: Organization (not Enterprise)
  Error: "Limited by Figma plan"

questions.prompt: Why is card_7 null in the Figma export answer?

options.text: The export hit the 32 megapixel cap, so Figma left out the largest image of the set
options.explanation: Figma scales larger images down. It does not drop them.

options.text: PNG is not allowed at scale 2, so one card out of the twelve failed by chance
options.explanation: Figma's scale range is 0.01 to 4, and the other eleven PNGs worked.

options.text: The card has 0% opacity, and Figma cannot render a node that has 0% opacity
options.explanation: Right. The Figma docs say a null means rendering failed, for example for a node with 0% opacity.

options.text: The image link for card_7 expired before the answer came back to the script
options.explanation: Figma's image links last 30 days. A null means the render failed.

questions.prompt: What is wrong with pasting the Canva export URLs into the launch doc for next month?

options.text: Nothing, because Canva keeps every export link alive until the design is deleted
options.explanation: The Canva docs say signed export URLs expire.

options.text: Signed export URLs expire, and the Canva docs say to use them now, not store or share them
options.explanation: Right. Download the files now, store them yourself, and send the agency the edit link too.

options.text: The links work only on a Free plan, so the agency needs to downgrade its account
options.explanation: No page says this. The plan changes export quality, not who can open a link.

options.text: The links open the design for editing, so the agency could change the posts
options.explanation: Export links are download links. The edit link is a separate URL.

questions.prompt: The developer wants Figma properties mapped to code props. What should the studio change?

options.text: Add more custom instructions in the UI, since they turn into property mappings
options.explanation: Instructions guide the AI. The Figma docs say the UI doesn't yet support property mapping.

options.text: Export the Button as SVG, because the SVG file includes the prop names in code
options.explanation: An export is a picture of the layer. It does not map Figma properties to props.

options.text: Nothing, because property mapping needs an Enterprise plan for both of the tools
options.explanation: Code Connect is available on Organization and Enterprise plans. The UI simply lacks this feature.

options.text: Set up the Button with the Code Connect CLI, which gives the AI property mapping
options.explanation: Right. The Figma docs list property mapping and dynamic code examples as CLI context for MCP.

questions.prompt: Why does the token sync script fail with "Limited by Figma plan"?

options.text: The Variables REST API needs a Full seat in an Enterprise org, and the studio has none
options.explanation: Right. The Figma docs say to use this API you must have a Full seat in an Enterprise org.

options.text: The script must call the POST endpoint first, because GET works only after a write
options.explanation: No page says this. The error names the plan.

options.text: Variables must be published as images first, using the GET image endpoint as well
options.explanation: The image endpoint renders layers. It has nothing to do with variables.

options.text: The file has too many variables, so Figma asks the studio to split it into two files
options.explanation: No page says this. The message is about the plan, not the size of the file.
